key_concepts: Materials can change in shape, size, or phase/state
Cutting lumber and grinding meat are changes in size
Melting ice is a change in phase or state
Rusting occurs when iron combines with oxygen
Rust is a product of combining iron and oxygen
Burning materials forms a new material
Spoiled food and browned apples are chemical changes
Broken glass is a physical change
Wet iron nails can form rust
Burning fuels can cause global warming
Acid rain forms from gaseous chemical wastes combining with air
